packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/__init.name: Charts package
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/__init.description: Marks the chart-drawing code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/annota.name: Annotation checks
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/annota.description: Re-exports the check for a chart's annotations.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/capabi.name: Chart capabilities
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/capabi.description: Lists the timeframes and indicators charts support.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/contro.name: Render a chart scene
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/contro.description: Builds a chart's current picture from its data.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/indica.name: Indicator maths
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/indica.description: Works out moving averages, RSI and other indicator lines for a chart.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/runtim.name: Chart refresh runtime
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/runtim.description: The always-on part that refreshes charts from official market snapshots, never fetching history itself.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/scene_.name: Scene to image
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/scene_.description: Draws a saved chart as an image, using only its stored data and no outside requests.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/scene..name: Chart scene
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/scene..description: Builds the chart scene the viewer draws.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/snapsh.name: Chart to PNG
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/snapsh.description: Turns the server's own chart drawing into a PNG image, with no scripts or outside resources.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/snapsh.name: Chart to SVG
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/snapsh.description: Draws the broker's price bars, wicks included, as an image.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/state..name: Chart state
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/state..description: Creates and updates a chart and replays the commands that change it.

packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/visual.name: Chart visual check
packages/charts/src/lonora_charts/visual.description: Takes a bounded, credential-free picture of a saved cloud chart to verify how it looks.
